finding: Slovak firms see upside inflation risks above euro area average
bullets: A net 61% of Slovak firms (n=242) saw upside risks to five-year inflation, 7 pp above the EA's net 54% (n=5,087), the widest divergence across the three economies in wave 39.
Slovak upside inflation risk perceptions rose mildly by 2.30 pp from a net 59% in wave 38, while the EA net balance eased marginally by 1.28 pp over the same period.
German firms reported a net 51% upside inflation risk, below both the EA and Slovak readings, placing Slovakia at the top of these three economies.
chart_subtitle: Net 61% of Slovak firms see upside inflation risk
